body.p: The following will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A robot, comprising:a first arm link;
a hollow shaft extending along a first axis thereof and coupled to the first arm link;
a first stage reduction assembly extending along a second axis thereof and coupled to a power source of the robot; and
a second stage reduction assembly comprising:
an input of the second stage reduction assembly coupled to an output of the first stage reduction assembly,
wherein the input of the second stage reduction assembly is adapted to rotate about [[a]] the second axis offset from the first axis; and
an output of the second stage reduction assembly coaxially arranged on a periphery of the hollow shaft,wherein the output of the second stage reduction assembly is adapted to engage with the input of the second stage reduction assembly to cause a rotation of the first arm link via the hollow shaft about the first axis;
wherein the first axis is offset from the second axis in a direction of the second stage reduction assembly; and
wherein the second stage reduction assembly further comprises a belt connected to the input of the second stage reduction assembly and the output of the second stage reduction assembly and via which the input of the second stage reduction assembly and the output of the second stage reduction assembly engage with each other.
2. (Previously Presented) The robot of claim 1, wherein the first stage reduction assembly comprises a gearhead coupled to an output shaft of the power source.
3. (Previously Presented) The robot of claim 1, further comprising:
at least one bearing arranged on the periphery of the hollow shaft.
4. (Currently Amended) The robot of claim 1, further comprising:
a second arm link connected to the first arm link via the hollow shaft, and wherein the hollow shaft and the first stage reduction assembly and the second stage reduction assembly assemblies are partially arranged in one of the first arm link and the second arm link[[s]].
5. (Canceled)
6. (Previously Presented) The robot of claim 1, wherein the belt comprises a synchronous belt.
7. (Canceled)
8. (Previously Presented) The robot of claim 1, wherein the hollow shaft is coupled to the first arm link via a keyway structure or screws, or the hollow shaft and the first arm link are integrally formed.
9. (Previously Presented) The robot of claim 1, the hollow shaft and the output of the second stage reduction assembly are integrally formed or assembled by interference fit or screw pressing.
10. (Currently Amended) An assembly method of a robot, comprising:providing a first arm link;
providing a hollow shaft extending along a first axis and coupled to the first arm link;
providing a first stage reduction assembly extending along a second axis and coupled to a power source; and
providing a second stage reduction assembly comprising:
an input of the second stage reduction assembly coupled to an output of the first stage reduction assembly,
wherein the input of the second stage reduction assembly is adapted to rotate about [[a]] the second axis offset from the first axis; and
an output of the second stage reduction assembly coaxially arranged on a periphery of the hollow shaft,wherein the output of the second stage reduction assembly is adapted to engage with the input of the second stage reduction assembly to cause a rotation of the first arm link via the hollow shaft about the first axis;
wherein the first axis is offset from the second axis in a direction of the second stage reduction assembly; and
wherein the second stage reduction assembly further comprises a belt connected to the input of the second stage reduction assembly and the output of the second stage reduction assembly and via which the input of the second stage reduction assembly and the output of the second stage reduction assembly engage with each other.
